q1_seek_guidance.title: The Elder's Wisdom
q1_seek_guidance.description: Speak to the Elder in the Starting Village to learn about the spreading darkness and the Obsidian Tower.

q2_light_the_way.title: Into the Crypt
q2_light_the_way.description: The Obsidian Tower is pitch black. Rumors say an ancient Lantern was left in the Forgotten Crypt. Find it to pierce the darkness.
q2_light_the_way.hint: The crypt entrance is near the village. Beware of the undead.

q3_high_ground.title: Prepare to Climb
q3_high_ground.description: To reach the hidden caves in the Rocky Hills, you need climbing gear. Find the Wandering Trader at the Crossroads and obtain a Sturdy Rope.
q3_high_ground.hint: Merchants love to trade. Make sure you have something of value or gold.

q4_lost_at_sea.title: Navigator's Tool
q4_lost_at_sea.description: The Enchanted Forest is a maze. Without a Compass, you will walk in circles. Search the Misty Lake for the lost compass.
q4_lost_at_sea.hint: The lake is thick with fog. The compass might be on the central island.

q5_unlock_the_spire.title: The Bone Key
q5_unlock_the_spire.description: The gate to the Obsidian Tower is locked. The key was buried with its master in the Forgotten Crypt long ago.
q5_unlock_the_spire.hint: Search the deepest part of the crypt, perhaps near the Lantern.

q6_confront_darkness.title: The Final Battle
q6_confront_darkness.description: Ascend the Obsidian Tower and defeat the Dark Wizard to save the valley.
q6_confront_darkness.hint: You will need the Lantern to see inside, the Compass to get through the forest, and the Key to open the door.
